name: Lambda Runtime Upgrade Report
description: Actionable assessment of AWS Lambda functions on deprecated/EOL runtimes: every CRITICAL function listed by region with concrete code/library upgrade recommendations, deletion candidates, effort-based grouping for HIGH/MEDIUM, and a prioritized migration playbook. Routes to the Ops Excellence domain (lambda-upgrade leaf agent).

sections.title: Lambda Runtime Upgrade Report
sections.prompt:
Produce the Lambda runtime upgrade report.

STEP 1: Call generate_upgrade_analysis with include_approaching_deprecation=true (omit 'regions' to auto-discover). This one call returns a field named 'report_markdown' that already contains the COMPLETE, pre-formatted report: executive summary, candidates for deletion, EVERY critical function grouped by region WITH its code/library recommendations, and the HIGH/MEDIUM effort grouping.

STEP 2: Output the value of 'report_markdown' EXACTLY as returned — verbatim, in full, do not summarize, truncate, re-order, or drop any rows or code-change bullets. It is already correct and complete.

STEP 3: After the report_markdown content, append these two short sections only:

## Migration Playbook
- Phase 1 (This Week): all 🔴 CRITICAL functions — start with the 🔴 SDK migrations.
- Phase 2 (This Month): 🟠 HIGH + 🟡 dependency rebuilds.
- Phase 3 (This Quarter): 🟡 MEDIUM + 🟢 quick-win batch.
Cost of inaction for CRITICAL: end-of-life runtimes get no security patches and AWS may block function updates.

## Rollback Plan
- Deploy upgrades behind Lambda versions + aliases; shift the alias gradually.
- Set CloudWatch error-rate + duration alarms before switching; roll back the alias on regression.

RULES: The body of the report MUST be the report_markdown field verbatim — this guarantees every critical function and its code recommendations are included. Do NOT rebuild the critical list from the structured fields yourself. This tool returns LIVE data from the real AWS account (data_source='live') — do NOT add any demo/mock/sample-data disclaimer; function names containing 'test'/'demo'/'sample' are real functions flagged for deletion, not mock data. Do NOT ask the user anything. Do NOT add follow-up questions. Execute immediately.
